scenarios.name: Attacking creatures you control have deathtouch, so a 2/2 attacker kills the 6/6 that blocks it
scenarios.ruling: Any nonzero damage dealt by a source with deathtouch is lethal damage, so the two damage from the attacking bear destroys the blocking 6/6.

scenarios.name: A creature you control that is blocking does not get deathtouch from the Bow
scenarios.ruling: The static ability grants deathtouch only to attacking creatures you control, so your blocker deals ordinary damage, the 6/6 attacker survives and its trample damage in excess of the blocker's toughness still reaches you.

scenarios.name: The first mode puts a +1/+1 counter on target creature
scenarios.ruling: You choose which mode you are using as you activate the ability; the first mode is one +1/+1 counter on a targeted creature and nothing else.

scenarios.name: The second mode deals 2 damage to a target creature with flying
scenarios.ruling: The second mode can only be pointed at a creature with flying; two damage is lethal to the 2/2 Drake and the ground creature beside it is untouched.

scenarios.name: The third mode gains you 3 life
scenarios.ruling: The third mode is a flat three life for the Bow's controller and touches nothing else.

scenarios.name: The fourth mode puts up to four target cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library
scenarios.ruling: The chosen cards leave the graveyard for the bottom of their owner's library, so the graveyard empties and the library grows by the same number.
